story.body: You heard that Burby entered Edward the Third for sixpence. The scenes are yours, from a fee years ago. You asked who had been asked leave, and got the question back. You named one line, lilies that fester, and left the claim unmade.

story.body: You looked at the line Harrison had just written. Burby, the play, sixpence, no name. You did not copy it into anything of yours.

story.body: You said the line was in Burby's book and in your coffer, and you did not open the folder to prove it. You named May beside this December. Then you ate.

story.body: You wrote the tailor who cannot read and still wants the play right, and the man who plays the wall. You kept Kemp's correction from the 27th. You did not finish the scene, and you did not number the leaf.
